ObservationIn.description:
One zone-minute. Signs and alignment are checked per row, not by the schema, so that a
single bad row does not reject the whole batch.
ObservationIn.title: ObservationIn

get.description: Newest first; filter by status (repeatable), level and zone (doc 14 §3.13).
Latest state of every zone (doc 14 §3.9). Uses the event's own data origin.
Time series per zone (doc 14 §3.10). One origin only; 5m = last occupancy, summed flows.

post.description: Validate a batch, upsert the valid rows, report the rejected ones (HTTP 200).

get.description: Newest first. ``next_cursor`` is opaque to clients: pass it back as ``?cursor=``.

patch.description: PLANNED -> LIVE (needs >= 1 zone and a valid graph) and LIVE -> ENDED; else 409.

get.description: Liveness and database check (doc 14 §3.16). 503 when the database is unreachable.

post.description: Make one model the active forecaster; the previous one is deactivated (doc 14 §3.15).

get.description: The latest cycle (doc 14 §3.11); a learned model's rows win over fallback rows.
Predictions by target time joined with the actual occupancy (doc 14 §3.12).
